Nexus","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system defines an authoritative yet dynamic marketplace interface tailored for modern academic-corporate coworking, innovation labs, and premium meeting room reservations. 

The aesthetic synthesizes **Corporate Modern** integrity with high-energy transactional elements. Rooted in traditional collegiate excellence—signaled by deep naval blues and structured grids—it integrates energetic retail and booking cues through high-visibility citrus accents and hyper-polished card interfaces. The interface must communicate institutional trust, frictionless operational scheduling, and forward-thinking collaboration.

Visual principles:
- **Disciplined Prestige**: Clean geometric layouts with clear structural hierarchies evoke institutional reliability without feeling bureaucratic.
- **High-Velocity Utility**: Crucial transactional triggers—pricing modules, instantaneous booking CTAs, and live availability indicators—command immediate focus using vivid functional accents.
- **Sculpted Fluidity**: Deeply curved card containers and soft surfaces soften the corporate structure, creating a contemporary, welcoming spatial booking atmosphere.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an 8-point structural system, maintaining an uncrowded presentation across dense marketplace listings and checkout flows.

### Grid Model
- **Desktop (1024px+)**: 12-column fluid grid, `2rem` (32px) margins, `1.5rem` (24px) gutters. Marketplace search interfaces deploy a fixed or sticky filter rail (3 columns) beside an active room card inventory (9 columns).
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px)**: 8-column layout, `1.5rem` (24px) margins, `1rem` (16px) gutters. Filter rails collapse into sliding surface trays.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: 4-column layout, `1rem` (16px) margins and gutters. Space cards stack vertically, utilizing horizontal snap-carousels for imagery.

### Spacing Density
- Internal container padding for primary cards scales from `1.5rem` (`space-lg`) on mobile to `2rem` (`space-xl`) on desktop to honor the expansive `32px` corner radii without clipping content.
- Inline controls, tag clouds, and metadata badges leverage tighter increments (`0.25rem` to `0.5rem`).

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy leverages crisp card boundaries against `#F5F7F9` canvas backgrounds, enhanced by soft ambient navy-tinted illumination.

### Elevation Levels
- **Base Canvas (`Level 0`)**: `#F5F7F9`. Flat, non-elevated background.
- **Standard Card Container (`Level 1`)**: Surface `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.06)`, shadow `0px 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.05)`. Used for space listings, amenity panels, and calendar grids.
- **Hover & Interactive State (`Level 2`)**: Surface `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.12)`, shadow `0px 12px 32px -4px rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.10)`. The card subtly translates `-2px` on the Y-axis.
- **Overlay & Sticky Booking Bar (`Level 3`)**: Surface `#FFFFFF`, shadow `0px 20px 40px -8px rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.16)`. Applied to MoMo QR modals, dynamic bottom booking trays on mobile, and active time-slot pickers.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary CTA ("Book Space", "Pay via MoMo")**: Vibrant orange `#FF7900` fill, white `#FFFFFF` Montserrat semi-bold text. On hover: darkened to `#E06A00`. Pressed: `#C75E00`. Minimum height 48px, corner radius `12px`.
- **Secondary Action**: Collegiate Navy `#003B71` outline (`1.5px`), transparent background, navy text. On hover: solid navy fill with white text.
- **Ghost Action**: Transparent background, text `#6B7280`. On hover: `#F5F7F9` background, `#111827` text.

### Badges & Status Pills
- **"Available Now" Badge**: Full pill shape (`rounded-full`), emerald green `#10B981` background at 10% opacity, solid `#059669` text, accompanied by a pulsing 6px `#10B981` radial dot.
- **MoMo QR Payment Pill**: Full pill shape, `#D82D8B` background, `#FFFFFF` text, paired with the MoMo micro-icon, optimized for instant recognition during checkout transitions.
- **Facility Tags**: Surface `#F5F7F9`, text `#6B7280`, radius `8px`, padding `4px 10px`.

### Room & Coworking Cards
- Pure white `#FFFFFF` surface container, rounded to `32px`, bordered by a subtle 1px stroke of `rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.06)`.
- Media container pinned to the top with matching `24px` internal radius or clipped upper half, featuring image carousels with an over-indexed availability pill top-left and pricing badge top-right.
- Content zone: Bold Montserrat title in `#003B71`, location caption in `#6B7280`, capacity icons in the center, and dynamic orange `#FF7900` hourly rate pinned bottom-right.

### Form Inputs & Search Filters
- Background `#FFFFFF`, border `1.5px solid #E5E7EB`, text `#111827`, border-radius `12px`.
- Focused state: Border transitions to `#003B71` with a `3px` focus ring of `rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.15)`.

- **Secondary (`#FF7900`)**: Vivid Workspace Orange serves exclusively as the action and commercial catalyst. Reserved for primary conversion buttons ("Book Space", "Instant Reserve"), dynamic pricing metrics, and crucial focus notifications.
- **Tertiary (`#10B981`)**: Emerald Green serves functional state validation, particularly instant room readiness, live occupancy counters, and confirmed calendar slots.
- **Payment & Auxiliary Accents**:
  - **MoMo Pink (`#A50064` / `#D82D8B`)**: Exclusively reserved for MoMo QR dynamic payment pills and payment checkout options.
  - **Surface Neutral (`#F5F7F9`)**: Soft slate-tinted canvas background, preventing glare and providing clear contrast behind crisp white containers.
  - **Foreground Body (`#111827`)**: Near-black charcoal used for dominant headers and body text to maximize legibility.
  - **Muted Text (`#6B7280`)**: Neutral slate used for metadata, room dimensions, equipment specs, and timestamps.

## Typography

The typography couples the architectural, assertive geometry of **Montserrat** with the functional clarity and mechanical neutrality of **Roboto Flex**.

- **Display & Headlines (`Montserrat`)**: Uses heavy weights (600 to 800) for space names, promotional banners, and numeric pricing values. Montserrat's open geometric apertures project modernity and optimism.
- **Body & Controls (`Roboto Flex`)**: Serves dense specifications (capacity metrics, hourly breakdowns, amenity lists, booking rules). Its utilitarian proportions guarantee legibility even at compact 11px and 12px pill labels.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an 8-point structural system, maintaining an uncrowded presentation across dense marketplace listings and checkout flows.

### Grid Model
- **Desktop (1024px+)**: 12-column fluid grid, `2rem` (32px) margins, `1.5rem` (24px) gutters. Marketplace search interfaces deploy a fixed or sticky filter rail (3 columns) beside an active room card inventory (9 columns).
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px)**: 8-column layout, `1.5rem` (24px) margins, `1rem` (16px) gutters. Filter rails collapse into sliding surface trays.
- **Mobile (< 768px)**: 4-column layout, `1rem` (16px) margins and gutters. Space cards stack vertically, utilizing horizontal snap-carousels for imagery.

### Spacing Density
- Internal container padding for primary cards scales from `1.5rem` (`space-lg`) on mobile to `2rem` (`space-xl`) on desktop to honor the expansive `32px` corner radii without clipping content.
- Inline controls, tag clouds, and metadata badges leverage tighter increments (`0.25rem` to `0.5rem`).

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy leverages crisp card boundaries against `#F5F7F9` canvas backgrounds, enhanced by soft ambient navy-tinted illumination.

### Elevation Levels
- **Base Canvas (`Level 0`)**: `#F5F7F9`. Flat, non-elevated background.
- **Standard Card Container (`Level 1`)**: Surface `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.06)`, shadow `0px 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.05)`. Used for space listings, amenity panels, and calendar grids.
- **Hover & Interactive State (`Level 2`)**: Surface `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.12)`, shadow `0px 12px 32px -4px rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.10)`. The card subtly translates `-2px` on the Y-axis.
- **Overlay & Sticky Booking Bar (`Level 3`)**: Surface `#FFFFFF`, shadow `0px 20px 40px -8px rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.16)`. Applied to MoMo QR modals, dynamic bottom booking trays on mobile, and active time-slot pickers.

## Shapes

The shape vocabulary emphasizes modern architectural comfort via pronounced border radii:

- **Primary Cards & Showcases**: Radii are set explicitly to `rounded-2xl` (`1rem` / 16px) for compact widgets, and a signature `rounded-[32px]` (`2rem`) for full-size room cards and hero containers.
- **Interactive Badges & Action Controls**:
  - Buttons and input fields feature `0.75rem` (12px) to `1rem` (16px) radii.
  - Status indicators (e.g., availability indicators, QR labels) adopt full pill silhouettes (`rounded-full` / 9999px) to contrast against the structured rectilinear card bodies.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary CTA ("Book Space", "Pay via MoMo")**: Vibrant orange `#FF7900` fill, white `#FFFFFF` Montserrat semi-bold text. On hover: darkened to `#E06A00`. Pressed: `#C75E00`. Minimum height 48px, corner radius `12px`.
- **Secondary Action**: Collegiate Navy `#003B71` outline (`1.5px`), transparent background, navy text. On hover: solid navy fill with white text.
- **Ghost Action**: Transparent background, text `#6B7280`. On hover: `#F5F7F9` background, `#111827` text.

### Badges & Status Pills
- **"Available Now" Badge**: Full pill shape (`rounded-full`), emerald green `#10B981` background at 10% opacity, solid `#059669` text, accompanied by a pulsing 6px `#10B981` radial dot.
- **MoMo QR Payment Pill**: Full pill shape, `#D82D8B` background, `#FFFFFF` text, paired with the MoMo micro-icon, optimized for instant recognition during checkout transitions.
- **Facility Tags**: Surface `#F5F7F9`, text `#6B7280`, radius `8px`, padding `4px 10px`.

### Room & Coworking Cards
- Pure white `#FFFFFF` surface container, rounded to `32px`, bordered by a subtle 1px stroke of `rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.06)`.
- Media container pinned to the top with matching `24px` internal radius or clipped upper half, featuring image carousels with an over-indexed availability pill top-left and pricing badge top-right.
- Content zone: Bold Montserrat title in `#003B71`, location caption in `#6B7280`, capacity icons in the center, and dynamic orange `#FF7900` hourly rate pinned bottom-right.

### Form Inputs & Search Filters
- Background `#FFFFFF`, border `1.5px solid #E5E7EB`, text `#111827`, border-radius `12px`.
- Focused state: Border transitions to `#003B71` with a `3px` focus ring of `rgba(0, 59, 113, 0.15)`.

### Checkboxes & Segmented Pickers
- Selected states fill with `#003B71`. Time-slot chips switch from `#F5F7F9` (unselected) to `#003B71` background with `#FFFFFF` text when selected.
